# Sample scripts

Made-up texts to show what the checker accepts and what it rejects.

## video-01.wav

**Voice, about 35 s**

Most orders reach a small bakery by phone in the evening.
The owner is busy at the oven and misses half of the calls.
In the morning those people already bought a cake somewhere else.
We connected an AI assistant to the bakery phone line.
The assistant answers in a few seconds, takes the order and asks for the pickup time.
A client asks “Can I pick it up at eight?” and gets an answer right away.
The order goes straight into a shared table with the name, the cake and the date.
The owner reads a short summary on her phone and starts baking.
Write to me and I will show you how it sounds on your own phone line.
